newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chip stocks roar back; end higher.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chip stocks roar back; end higher.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks roared back from a large deficit to end higher Monday after bargain hunters re-emerged but the overall mood of the market was unsettled by speculation that the Federal Reserve would boost interest rates next week.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average closed up 20.02 points at 6,955.48 following a fast-paced recovery from a loss of more than 80 points. But in the broader market, declining issues beat advances by 2-1 on active volume of 496 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
